text.text_excerpt: Wow! Do yourself a favor and get over to Vom Fass. This is a local franchise of a European specialty foods retailer (one of only 3 locations in the US). They sell cask stored oils, vinegars, and liquor. I am OMG-obsessed with the avocado oil. Weird, right? Wait until you taste it. They offer tastings of all their items so you can try before you buy. You do have to purchase bottles to store your liquids though and the bottles are a range of prices depending on size and fanciness. You can bring the bottles back for a re-fill.

German chain of bulk oils, vinegars, and fancy booze. Walking in, we were greeted by a very nice salesperson who gave us the rundown on how to buy from the store. The look of wonder and awe must have given us away as first timers. We learned that "vom fass" is German for "from the cask." Along one wall are vinegars and oils. They are stored in ceramic containers with a little valve to fill the bottle of your choice. Along the back wall are pre-filled bottles of liqueurs ranging from absinthe to vanilla cream and many more. Another wall has miniature wooden barrels stacked in up that will soon be filled with single-malt scotches, cognacs, and other fancy spirits. The barrels were labeled, ...

At first when I saw the name of this store, I was like "uhhh, bad idea." I mean, the name conjures up uncomfortable images and I don't want to "vom fass" when drinking or eating (in case I was just being super subtle there)... Aaaand if you speak German, you are surely laughing at me right now. Translation "Straight from the cask"... Translation: LOTS OF SAMPLES!!! Spirits sensation! This store, simply rocks. Although I was looking for elderflower liqueur, that was about all that they don't have, flavor wise.
